take: Per Toronto's announcement, the Maple Leafs placed forward Miles Wood on injured reserve and acquired forward Aatu Räty from Vancouver for forwards Brandon Buhr and Jacob Quillan. Räty has one goal in four games this season with the Canucks, playing 10.16 minutes a night, and his team has taken only 28.1% of the expected goals at five-on-five with him on the ice. Toronto sits at 3-3-2 and holds 44.6% of the expected goals overall, so Räty arrives on a team that is currently being outchanced.
